crossRefs.note: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

people.name: Joppa
people.line: An ancient seaport, the main port for Jerusalem

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

people.name: Simon
people.line: A tanner in Joppa who hosted Peter.

translations.web: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
translations.bsb: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
translations.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
translations.asv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call unto thee Simon, who is surnamed Peter; he lodgeth in the house of Simon a tanner, by the sea side.
